description: Fetches one vertodigital.com page as clean markdown, with navigation, footer and scripts left out: service pages, case studies, blog posts, ebooks, event recaps, legal pages and more. Use it once you know which page you want; find slugs with vertodigital_get_site_index, or take the case-studies/<slug> links from vertodigital_search_case_studies results. For contact details alone, vertodigital_get_contact with format: "summary" is cheaper. slug is forgiving: a bare path (case-studies/ironscales), a /markdown/<slug>.md path and a full vertodigital.com URL all resolve to the same page, and an empty slug returns the homepage. Fetched live on every call. An unknown slug returns an isError result pointing to vertodigital_get_site_index, never an exception, so guessing a slug is safe.

slug.description: Page path without leading slash or extension. Examples: "about", "services", "case-studies/ironscales", "services/inbound/b2b-and-saas-linkedin-advertising". A full vertodigital.com URL or a /markdown/<slug>.md path is also accepted.

name: vertodigital_get_page

markdown.description: The document as markdown - identical to the text content block.

slug.description: The normalised slug that was fetched

url.description: Canonical URL of the page on vertodigital.com
